title: LMC X-4
description: optimization with a grain of quality of life
body:
# Introduction

[**LMC X-4**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LMC_X-4) is third smallest star known to human-kind, and serves as an extension of [SGR-J1935](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sgr-j1935)

Instead of only optimizing game (like SGR-J1935), we are also adding quality of life mods, that could help you on multiplayer servers or singleplayer.

# Extensions

There are only two extensions of LMC X-4, and you're currently looking at one of them.

- [SGR-J1935](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sgr-j1935) contains only optimization and doesn't add/change vanilla gameplay mechanics in anyway, which LMC X-4 might do.

# Version System

LMC X-4 (and extensions) uses `W.X.Y.Z` format for release versions.

- `W` will increment each new Minecraft version release.
- `X` will increment with any changes to the list of mods.
- `Y` will increment with any updates to any mods in the list.
- `Z` will increment with any hotfixes to the modpack.
